I also couldn't read the existing automation list for the same reason, so I can't yet confirm there's no duplicate job. Nothing is scheduled, and no digest has been posted.

Once the gateway auth is fixed, I'll retry. The plan:

- **When:** every Monday at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 2026-10-19.
- **What:** a digest in this channel covering the previous seven days from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items from #coastal-team. I'll read only those two channels, not DMs or other channels.
- **Finance:** I'll leave out money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts, payment terms) and finance documents. Those go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark and the account owner, not a channel. Operational facts like seat counts, renewal dates, ticket numbers and contacts stay in.
